thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered: rate-guard-quota-alert (pd://INC123456) — multiple 429s observed at ingress-proxy. Automatic page to on-call.
PagerDuty: Page delivered to Sophia G (primary) and on-call-manager.
Sophia G: I'll take this, logging in now. seeing spikes in 429s and quota-enforce logs spiking.
Raj P: Can you confirm customer impact? any high-importance tenants?
Sophia G: yep two big tenants (tenant:acme-corp, tenant:beta-inc) showing 5xx=low but 429 high. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/ratelimit/429-spike
Mike H: incident-bot, any recent deploys touching quota-mapper or rateguard?
incident-bot: Deploy webhook: service=quota-mapper, user=ci-system, sha=abc1234, started 2026-03-15T01:12:09Z
Sophia G: looks like quota-mapper restarted around that time. grabbing logs.
Sophia G:
```
[2026-03-15T01:12:11Z] quota-mapper ERROR apply_mapping failed: key collision tenant->opaque_tag
[2026-03-15T01:12:12Z] quota-mapper INFO reload complete
[2026-03-15T01:12:13Z] rate-guard WARN misapplied quota for tenant=acme-corp -> global catch-all
```
Lisa (ops): oof. Could be config migration bug. Can we flip to fallback limiter while we investigate?
Evan Reed: Suggest set RATEGUARD_MODE=soft-fallback on all ingesters; command below to run as runbook step 3.
Sophia G: running the runbook step now:
```
# runbook step: enable soft-fallback
kubectl -n prod exec deploy/rate-guard -- /bin/sh -c 'echo soft > /etc/rateguard/mode && pkill -HUP rateguard'
```
Sophia G: command ran, restarting pods.
Lisa (ops): Output from rollout: pod/rate-guard-7f8 restarted, pod/rate-guard-8g2 restarted
oncall-manager: PagerDuty escalation: second on-call (Mike H) notified — ack status: pending
Mike H: ack'ing the PD incident. joining.
PagerDuty: Acknowledged by Mike H.
Sophia G: After fallback: 429s for acme-corp dropped from 18% -> 1.2% in 3m. continuing to monitor.
Raj P: good. did we preserve quota accounting? any token loss?
Sophia G: quota counters appear intact; mapping was temporarily redirecting to global tag due to key collision. need postmortem.
Mike H: Can we re-run mapping migration with safe-check? avoid dual writes.
Evan Reed: creating hotfix: add strict schema validation and an atomic swap. I'll push to staging.
Lisa (ops): Customer comms: OpsAlert -> ACME Pager sent. Mike please prepare note for account team.
Mike H: drafting note: "we observed transient quota misapplication that caused rate-limiting on your traffic; mitigated by enabling fallback; we will follow up with root-cause and timeline."
incident-bot: pd://INC123456 status: acknowledged -> resolved pending closure when all 429s cleared.
Sophia G: metrics steady at baseline for 12m, error budget unaffected. closing PD: resolving now.
PagerDuty: Incident INC123456 resolved by Sophia G.
oncall-manager: Thanks team. Follow-ups: JIRA RW-5021 (quota-mapper migration fix), schedule postmortem for 24h, add extra canary checks to deploy pipeline.
Sophia G: noted. Great response. cc: @eng-runtime @eng-sre
Mike H: thumbs up :thumbsup:
Evan Reed: leaving a retrospective note in #postmortems and assigning owners.
Sophia G: incident closed. great job everyone. :tada:
